season.activationDateSource: TzKT block 13857889 timestamp (level and protocol identity from data/governance-refresh-report.json currentProtocol)

sources.name: TzKT
sources.role: protocol activation, operations, accounts, contracts, delegation retention

sources.name: OBJKT API v3
sources.role: season mint and listing-sale events with profile identity

transaction.completeClaim: Complete against the observed confirmed TzKT index and matching full-range raw count; the last 128 levels are replacement-replayed on refresh.

objktMints.source: OBJKT new-token event(event_type=mint, token.timestamp in season)

governance.source: TzKT ballots + proposals + actionable voting-period sequence

paginationBounds.policy: A source that reaches its bound withholds only dependent lanes; unrelated complete lanes remain publishable.

bridge.reason: No canonical Etherlink L1 deposit contract and address-attribution rule is frozen in this season taxonomy. Publishing a bridge winner would be unsafe.

transaction.title: Transaction Maxi
transaction.coverage: Requires an exhaustive TzKT operation scan; no winner is published when the bounded source cannot be exhausted.

collector.title: Collector Maxi
collector.coverage: OBJKT-indexed listing sales only. Private transfers and sales outside the OBJKT index are not counted.

artist.title: Art Maxi
artist.coverage: Collaborative-token volume is divided equally across unflagged creators so a single sale is not multiplied.

minter.title: Mint Maxi
minter.coverage: OBJKT-indexed, non-reverted mint events for tokens first created during the season, joined to positive-price primary OBJKT listing sales. Remints of older tokens are excluded.

defi.title: DeFi Maxi
defi.coverage: Curated TzKT-alias taxonomy. Unknown, unlabeled, or newly deployed app contracts are outside coverage until the next season taxonomy is frozen.

gaming.title: Gaming Maxi
gaming.coverage: Curated TzKT-alias taxonomy. Unknown, unlabeled, or newly deployed game contracts are outside coverage until the next season taxonomy is frozen.

governance.title: Governance Maxi
governance.reason: No qualifying season activity was found.
governance.coverage: Applied TzKT ballot and proposal operations attributed to implicit delegates.

staking.title: Staking Growth Maxi
staking.coverage: Applied TzKT staking operations. This trajectory lane is separate from the live absolute-stake Crown Hall.

delegation.title: Delegation Maxi
delegation.coverage: Applied TzKT delegation operations reconciled against snapshot or exact-close state. This is retained in-season assignment, not proof of first-ever acquisition or marketing attribution.

liquidity.title: Liquidity Maxi
liquidity.coverage: Partial entrypoint coverage only; a distinct target is called a venue, not assumed to be one pool. Supplied value and LP duration are not scored.

bridge.reason: No canonical Etherlink L1 deposit contract and address-attribution rule is frozen in this season taxonomy. Publishing a bridge winner would be unsafe.
bridge.title: Bridge Maxi

builder.title: Builder Maxi
builder.coverage: Conservative TzKT scope: top-level direct originations only. Factory/internal originations and deployments without independent use do not qualify.

unicorn.title: Season Unicorn
unicorn.coverage: Only ready on-chain season lanes participate. Social sharing never contributes to Unicorn.

leaders.title: Transaction Maxi
leaders.method: Most successful top-level transactions sent during the protocol season, then distinct active days.

leaders.title: Collector Maxi
leaders.method: Most distinct unflagged artists collected through OBJKT listing sales during the protocol season; buy volume and purchase count break ties.

leaders.title: Art Maxi
leaders.method: Most distinct unflagged, non-self collectors of an artist's work in OBJKT listing sales during the protocol season; attributed volume and sales break ties.

leaders.title: Mint Maxi
leaders.method: Most season-minted tokens with a positive-price primary creator sale to an independent collector, then distinct mints, collectors, and primary-sale editions.

leaders.title: DeFi Maxi
leaders.method: Most distinct recognized DeFi apps used during the protocol season, then successful top-level wallet calls and recognized contracts.

leaders.title: Gaming Maxi
leaders.method: Most distinct recognized Tezos games used during the protocol season, then successful top-level wallet calls and recognized contracts.

leaders.title: Governance Maxi
leaders.reason: No qualifying season activity was found.
leaders.method: Most distinct actionable Tezos voting windows participated in during the protocol season, then streak across the ordered proposal, exploration, and promotion sequence and ballots plus proposals.

leaders.title: Staking Growth Maxi
leaders.method: Largest positive net stake added by a staker during the protocol season, then gross stake and stake-operation count.

leaders.title: Delegation Maxi
leaders.method: Most non-self wallets whose latest in-season assignment changed baker and still points to that baker with positive account balance, then retained balance.

leaders.title: Liquidity Maxi
leaders.method: Most recognized liquidity contracts reached through frozen positive-supply entrypoints, then app breadth and successful top-level calls.

leaders.title: Bridge Maxi
leaders.reason: No canonical Etherlink L1 deposit contract and address-attribution rule is frozen in this season taxonomy. Publishing a bridge winner would be unsafe.
leaders.method: Canonical Etherlink L1 deposits during the protocol season. Withdrawals and round trips are deliberately excluded.

leaders.title: Builder Maxi
leaders.method: Most directly originated contracts from an implicit sender that received successful post-deploy use from another implicit account, then user and call breadth.

leaders.title: Season Unicorn
leaders.method: Breadth across same-season top 100 merit lanes; normalized rank points break ties. Requires 3 lanes.
